Details.JobSummary: About the Position: This position is located at Yokota Middle School. Yokota Middle School is a Department of Defense Education Activity School (DoDEA) located on Yokota Air Base, Japan. Yokota Air Base is located on the island of Honshu, Japan, on the Kanto Plain, 28 miles northwest of Tokyo at the foothills of the Okutama Mountains. Federal employees in Yokota, Japan are currently entitled to receive a 42% Post Allowance (COLA) in addition to the base salary.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: Department of Defense Education Activity (DoDEA), as one of only two Federally-operated school systems, is responsible for planning, directing, coordinating, and managing prekindergarten through 12th grade educational programs on behalf of the Department of Defense (DoD). DoDEA is globally positioned, operating 160 accredited schools in 8 districts located in 11 foreign countries, 7 states, Guam, and Puerto Rico. DoDEA employs approximately 15,000 employees who serve more than 72,000 children of active duty military and DoD civilian families. DoDEA is committed to ensuring that all school-aged children of military families are provided a world-class education that prepares them for postsecondary education and/or career success and to be leading contributors in their communities as well as in our 21st century globalized society. .
MajorDuties: Create a variety of documents from multiple software types.
Maintain files related to school correspondence.
Assist in entering and retrieving information in the school database.
Manage supplies and materials.
Distribute information of interest and concern to school personnel.

Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: Thank you for considering employment with Air Force Services Non-Appropriated Funds (NAF). The 374 Force Support Squadron is a team of 1,000+ military, civilians and local nationals. We work together to provide enhanced quality of life for the 12,000 Yokota Air Base community members and over 150,000 transient personnel that visit Yokota every year via facilities and programs centered on morale, welfare, recreation and total force development. Our operations are the fourth largest in the Air Force: 13 dining facilities; personnel readiness and accountability; lodging; fitness; recreation; resiliency; child and youth programs; community building; mortuary affairs; NEO; Professional Development; and Education and Training. The squadron is comprised of eight flights, 49 activities and 159 facilities.
MajorDuties: Performs a variety responsible clerical support tasks; to include file maintenance, reservations, scheduling, answering and referring telephone calls and visitors to appropriate staff or office. Appropriately enrolls and ensures participants are signed in and out in accordance with established procedures. Provides information and answers question concerning type and availability of programs. Assist patrons with completing forms. Monitors parents signing children in and out of center. Denies admission of children with obvious illness. Computes, collects, and records fees and miscellaneous transactions. Prepares end of day/month reports. Tracks and records daily GPC (APF & NAF} transactions, credit cards, and petty cash/change funds transactions. Tracks and records daily customer payments, automatic payments, payment for contracted instructors. Prepares supporting financial documents such as accounting and financial reports, fund transfer reports, and other reports such as enrollment, attendance, and program usage reports. Notifies supervisor of any deficiencies. Uses word processing software to produce and prepare a variety of documents, reports, forms, messages, memorandums, statistical or tabular material, and other miscellaneous correspondence here spacing arrangement are complicated, directly into final form without a rough draft. Arranges the material in the form necessitated by the nature of the subject matter, the purpose for which it is to be used, the format required regulations, style manuals or policy. Transmits and receives documents and messages electronically using personal computer or workstation that is networked or linked to other computers or workstations throughout the work area or organization. Assist enrolling children into programs and checks patrons in to/out of center. Clerically assists in tracking and preparing activity program plans, reports, and staff schedules. Assists in preparing and posts duty schedules of staff to ensure that an adequate number of personnel are on duty. Assists with schedules personnel for required annual training. Uses time management software to perform duties as time keeper, responsible for entering and recording time and attendance records. Performs a variety of general office duties such as receiving telephone call and visitors, routing and filing correspondence, and maintaining files. Maintains bulletin board with up to date and accurate information. Performs other related duties as assigned.
